description: A person who purchases goods or services for personal use.
A fault, imperfection, or shortcoming in a product's quality or performance.
A shortcoming in the quality, nature, or manner of performance of a service.
Deceptive, misleading, or fraudulent business conduct.
Legal responsibility of a seller/manufacturer for defective products.
A disagreement where the consumer's complaint is denied or disputed.
A problem arising under the terms of a product or service warranty.
A matter concerning the request, denial, or non-receipt of a refund.
A consumer problem that originates from an online purchase.
An agreement enforceable by law between two or more parties involving mutual promises and consideration.
Failure by one party to perform their obligations under a contract without lawful excuse.
Complete refusal or failure to carry out an agreed contractual obligation.
A dispute arising from non-payment or late payment of a contractual obligation.
Violation of a specific term or condition of a contract by one of the parties.
A legal arrangement where a tenant occupies property owned by a landlord under a rental agreement.
A sum of money paid by a tenant to a landlord as a guarantee against damage or non-payment of rent.
A disagreement between landlord and tenant regarding rent payment, amount, or increase.
Rights and duties of landlord and tenant under the rental agreement and applicable law.
The legal process of removing a tenant from a rented property.
Fraudulent activities conducted through the internet or digital means resulting in financial loss.
Gaining access to a computer system or network without permission.
Fraudulent use of another person's identity credentials in electronic form.
Harassment, intimidation, or threatening behavior conducted through electronic communication.
Unauthorized copying, downloading, or extraction of data from a computer or network.
